我们下个月要推一款智能生活 App，主要是让美国年轻人觉得日常生活能方便一点，然后愿意下载试试。预算比较小，我还没想清楚该找哪几类博主，你先帮我捋一捋。

可以。这次先做推广规划，**不启动新搜索**；此前已登记的筛选任务不受影响。

你现在的目标是：让美国年轻人看到“这个 App 能帮我省事”，继而愿意下载试用。小预算下，建议先按**使用场景和可信的实际演示能力**选博主，不必延续前一批的 geek 外观、眼镜或族裔条件。

### 初步考虑的 3 类博主
*以下是方向建议，具体要看 App 功能再确定。*

| 类型 | 对下载目标的作用 | 适合的内容 |
|---|---|---|
| **日常生活／个人效率型** | 把功能融入真实生活，让观众理解“我为什么需要它” | 一天的生活流程、安排事务、使用前后对比 |
| **大学生活／初入职场型** | 用美国年轻人的具体困扰建立共鸣 | 上课、通勤、租房、工作与生活安排中的省事场景 |
| **实用 App／轻科技体验型** | 清楚演示操作，降低下载和上手门槛 | “这个 App 帮我少做了哪几步”、短教程、真实体验 |

预算小时，我会优先考虑**受众契合的个人小型创作者、自然的使用演示，以及可追踪的下载入口**，而不是只看粉丝数。以上类型可能重叠，最终名单会去重。

先补充这 **4 点**，我就能整理成可确认的分组方案：

1. **App 最核心的 1–3 个功能是什么？** 最好举一个“原来很麻烦，用它就方便”的场景；也请说明支持 iOS、Android 哪些系统。
2. **“美国年轻人”主要指谁？** 比如大学生、刚工作的年轻人，或某个年龄段。
3. **预算大概是多少美元？** 是纯博主合作费，还是还包含广告投放、内容制作等？
4. **平台有没有限制？** 只做 Instagram，还是也考虑 TikTok、YouTube？这次更看重下载量，还是下载后完成首次使用？

你可以按“功能／人群／预算／平台与目标”简短回答。随后我会给出 **2–4 类博主、各类人数、粉丝范围和候选分析预算**的草案，等你确认后再执行。

### 建议先考虑的 3 类博主

| 类型 | 为什么适合 | 可考虑的内容形式 |
|---|---|---|
| **周末城市短途游／城市探索型** | 与两天一夜、火车出行、城市步行等场景直接对应，让背包成为行程中自然使用的装备 | 周末行程＋打包清单、一个包完成城市短途游 |
| **轻徒步／入门户外型** | 展示短路线上的携带需求，帮助观众判断它是否适合自己的轻户外活动 | 一日徒步装备、城市到郊外的周末路线；不预设专业登山性能 |
| **旅行打包／实用装备体验型** | 回答容量、分区、重量、舒适度等购买前问题，更接近下单决策 | 实装演示、使用体验、适合与不适合的场景 |

**小规模首轮建议：**前两类负责呈现使用场景，第三类负责解释产品与购买理由。具体配额等预算、产品卖点和平台确定后再分配，同一账号不重复占名额。

### 需要你确认的范围
下面这 5 组信息最影响方案，可以简短回答：

1. **产品与售价**  
   售价多少英镑？容量、重量和最突出的2–3个卖点是什么？例如收纳、舒适度、防泼水——只采用你能确认的功能，不自行假设。

2. **英国销售条件**  
   网店是否已支持英国下单？运费、预计配送时间、退换货安排如何？这些会直接影响购买转化。

3. **预算与合作方式**  
   总预算大概多少？是否包含样品及寄送？倾向付费内容、赠品合作、佣金分成，还是组合方式？赠品不等于博主一定会发内容。

4. **平台与创作者范围**  
   想做 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube，还是先选一个？创作者必须住在英国，还是**英国受众契合即可**？英语内容是必选还是优先？

5. **规模、时间与下单追踪**  
   希望先合作几人、何时上线？有没有专属链接、折扣码或联盟佣金系统，用来追踪订单？

**25–35岁、英国、喜欢城市短途游和轻徒步**目前是目标受众画像，不自动等于博主本人的年龄或所在地；受众构成没有可靠数据时，会明确标为未核实。

{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

{"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

Each year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.

On a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.

Save this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.

{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

{"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

{"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

Each year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.

On a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.

Save this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.

{"caption":"One year ago I left a $118,000 software engineering job. Since January: 25+ brand partnerships, over $200,000, no agency, no manager.

Four things got me here. Post before you’re ready, then let the data refine it. Pick a cadence and hold it. Know your niche before everyone else does. And be your own brand manager, because some deals came to me, but only after I built something worth finding.

One year out, zero regrets. Save this if you’re starting, and follow for the full brand deal breakdown.

{"caption":"Aritzia dropped their first ever men’s sweatfleece so I ordered $900 worth to find out what’s actually different from the unisex.

And the two bottoms come down to whether you want a cuffed ankle, the Jogger, or a straight leg, the Mega Straight. If you already own the unisex, size accordingly since the men’s runs broader.

{"caption":"The iPhone Duo is a 5.4 inch phone closed and a 7.6 inch screen open, 50 percent bigger than the 18 Pro Max. {"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

#smarthome #homeautomation #hometel #eightsleep #sleeproutine","likes":76412,"comments":366,"photoCount":0,"videoCoverCount":1}

{"caption":"My apartment basically runs itself, and I’m not exaggerating.

These are the 4 things doing my chores for me: Easyplants that water themselves, a Roomba that cleans my floors on a schedule (and spot-cleans any mess from the app), a Pura that keeps my place smelling like a 5-star resort on a timer, and smart plugs that run all my lights so they’re on at sunset and off by 10. {"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

Each year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.

On a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.

Save this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.

### 初步考虑的 3 类博主
*以下是方向建议，具体要看 App 功能再确定。*

| 类型 | 对下载目标的作用 | 适合的内容 |
|---|---|---|
| **日常生活／个人效率型** | 把功能融入真实生活，让观众理解“我为什么需要它” | 一天的生活流程、安排事务、使用前后对比 |
| **大学生活／初入职场型** | 用美国年轻人的具体困扰建立共鸣 | 上课、通勤、租房、工作与生活安排中的省事场景 |
| **实用 App／轻科技体验型** | 清楚演示操作，降低下载和上手门槛 | “这个 App 帮我少做了哪几步”、短教程、真实体验 |

预算小时，我会优先考虑**受众契合的个人小型创作者、自然的使用演示，以及可追踪的下载入口**，而不是只看粉丝数。以上类型可能重叠，最终名单会去重。

先补充这 **4 点**，我就能整理成可确认的分组方案：

1. **App 最核心的 1–3 个功能是什么？** 最好举一个“原来很麻烦，用它就方便”的场景；也请说明支持 iOS、Android 哪些系统。
2. **“美国年轻人”主要指谁？** 比如大学生、刚工作的年轻人，或某个年龄段。
3. **预算大概是多少美元？** 是纯博主合作费，还是还包含广告投放、内容制作等？
4. **平台有没有限制？** 只做 Instagram，还是也考虑 TikTok、YouTube？这次更看重下载量，还是下载后完成首次使用？

你可以按“功能／人群／预算／平台与目标”简短回答。随后我会给出 **2–4 类博主、各类人数、粉丝范围和候选分析预算**的草案，等你确认后再执行。

选人重点是：博主能否展示“周末出门怎么装、背着走一天是否方便”，以及观众是否有相应出行和购买需求。

### 建议先考虑的 3 类博主

| 类型 | 为什么适合 | 可考虑的内容形式 |
|---|---|---|
| **周末城市短途游／城市探索型** | 与两天一夜、火车出行、城市步行等场景直接对应，让背包成为行程中自然使用的装备 | 周末行程＋打包清单、一个包完成城市短途游 |
| **轻徒步／入门户外型** | 展示短路线上的携带需求，帮助观众判断它是否适合自己的轻户外活动 | 一日徒步装备、城市到郊外的周末路线；不预设专业登山性能 |
| **旅行打包／实用装备体验型** | 回答容量、分区、重量、舒适度等购买前问题，更接近下单决策 | 实装演示、使用体验、适合与不适合的场景 |

**小规模首轮建议：**前两类负责呈现使用场景，第三类负责解释产品与购买理由。具体配额等预算、产品卖点和平台确定后再分配，同一账号不重复占名额。

### 需要你确认的范围
下面这 5 组信息最影响方案，可以简短回答：

1. **产品与售价**  
   售价多少英镑？容量、重量和最突出的2–3个卖点是什么？例如收纳、舒适度、防泼水——只采用你能确认的功能，不自行假设。

2. **英国销售条件**  
   网店是否已支持英国下单？运费、预计配送时间、退换货安排如何？这些会直接影响购买转化。

3. **预算与合作方式**  
   总预算大概多少？是否包含样品及寄送？倾向付费内容、赠品合作、佣金分成，还是组合方式？赠品不等于博主一定会发内容。

4. **平台与创作者范围**  
   想做 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube，还是先选一个？创作者必须住在英国，还是**英国受众契合即可**？英语内容是必选还是优先？

5. **规模、时间与下单追踪**  
   希望先合作几人、何时上线？有没有专属链接、折扣码或联盟佣金系统，用来追踪订单？

**25–35岁、英国、喜欢城市短途游和轻徒步**目前是目标受众画像，不自动等于博主本人的年龄或所在地；受众构成没有可靠数据时，会明确标为未核实。

你补充这些信息后，我再整理成独立方案卡，列出各类配额、粉丝范围、候选分析预算、必选条件和偏好，供你先看，不启动搜索。

两项独立研究已一次登记，**都只看 @tylerlcrawford 和 @valstechtalkk，不搜索相似账号**。

| 研究 | 核验方式 | 入选目标 |
|---|---|---:|
| 第一项：文字分析 | 只分析已有简介和帖子文字，不打开网页，可先独立执行 | 1位 |
| 第二项：公开主页核验 | 等你交还桌面后，再打开两人的本人公开主页核验 | 1位 |

两项均保留这些要求：
- 粉丝 **1万–10万**，国家不限。
- **数码内容、个人创作者身份**分别作为必选条件。
- **两人全部分析并标注内容方向**，不会达到1位入选后就跳过另一人。

你操作桌面期间，网页项保持等待，不动浏览器。网页项必须取得**本轮本人主页的实际访问证据**；无法取得的条件会保留为待核实，不用旧资料冒充新核验。
